name: hydro-dmrv
description: Digital MRV for run-of-river hydropower: a 5-layer verifier publishes raw readings and verdicts on HCS so anyone can reproduce them, a Solidity registry mints HTS RECs and HTS NFT retirement certificates, and Chainlink HBAR/USD with a Supra fallback settles USD-priced sales in HBAR. Ships an MCP server so AI agents can verify, audit, reproduce and buy with their own wallets.

steps.text: Hydro dMRV composes HCS (raw readings + verdicts, reproducible by anyone), HTS (REC token and NFT certificates created by the contract) and Chainlink + Supra oracles (USD-priced settlement). README.md walks through the whole flow; AGENTS.md briefs coding agents.

sections.title: Try it locally (no Hedera account needed)

steps.label: Deploy mocks for HTS, Chainlink and Supra, then HydroREC and the demo plant
Put hederaLocalFork first in packages/nextjs/scaffold.config.ts, then start the app
Import its key as the deployer
Deploy (creates the HTS token and NFT collection, prints Hashscan links)
Verify a day of generation, publish readings and report to HCS, mint RECs
